data.body: RCA (2026-09-07): the defect is not missing import-convention guards; the existing guards already catch forbidden imports, but only when invoked through the bare pytest console-script path that omits the checkout root from sys.path. Developers running targeted checks with python -m pytest get a false green because cwd is injected onto sys.path, so tests-rooted imports resolve locally and only fail later under make test/CI's bare pytest. The appropriate fix is visibility/routing through the documented pre-push path and in-test warnings, without adding another AST scan, matching the handoff constraint and the recorded operator ruling.
